Messages.Author: Santiago
Messages.Body:
If Minion X is bleeding me, and I have an untapped Minion A with a
Starshell Grenade Launcher, can Minion A tap to reduce X's stealth by 1,
untap via Rat's Warning/Guard Dogs, and tap again to reduce stealth by a
total of 2? (It's possible the two reductions might not be cumulative,
for some reason.)

>Also in the same vein.

>Can the minion with the SGL tap as a part of their inherent block

There is no inherent block attempt.

>Say Minion be is bleeding with +1 stealth, can minion A (as above) use
>the SGL as part of the block attempt.

He can do it while attempting to block, sure. But once he taps, he's
no longer elligible to block unless he plays a Wake or some untap
effect (like Rat's Warning).
